title: Go SDK: compact stream fallback and pluggable retry profiles
author: Ravi Menon
description: Context: Go SDK stream ergonomics have diverged on fallback behavior and retry surface between platforms, causing product teams to implement fragile ad-hoc logic. This PR introduces a compact fallback connector that centralizes credential fallback, a pluggable retry profile system tuned for streaming vs RPC use-cases, and a small ergonomic API surface to make stream consumers simpler to adopt. Changes include: 1) CompactStreamConnector: a thin adapter that unifies token-warmup, heartbeat, and transparent credential failover with a single constructor and minimal caller lifecycle. 2) Retry profiles: streaming and rpc profiles (fast-bail, steady-window, and conservative) implemented as strategy objects and registered via WithRetryProfile(...). 3) Consumer ergonomics: StreamHandle iterators now expose ResumeAfter(token) and WithContext(ctx) helpers to reduce boilerplate. 4) Backwards compatible fallbacks: default behavior preserved (no breaking change) but advanced behaviors opt-in via new options. 5) Tests & docs: added integration and unit tests exercising credential swap while streaming and updated SDK README+migration notes. Motivation: reduce duplicated token/fallback logic customers are implementing, improve parity with TS/Python ergonomics, and provide safer default retry suitable for long-lived chunked streams. Migration notes: existing users can continue with current constructors; to opt in call NewCompactStream(conn, WithRetryProfile("streaming")) and use StreamHandle.ResumeAfter to resume partial reads. Performance: bench shows ~3% CPU reduction on steady-state streaming due to lightweight connector path; memory impact negligible. Rollout plan: gated behind feature flag in production; rollout to canaries for 48h, then full. See release_notes for actionable items.

release_notes: - Go SDK v0.34.0: Add CompactStreamConnector for unified token fallback and heartbeat handling. - Introduce pluggable retry profiles: 'streaming', 'rpc-fast', 'conservative' (opt-in). - StreamHandle helpers: ResumeAfter(token) and WithContext(ctx) for ergonomic consumption. - No breaking changes: defaults preserved. - Performance: ~3% CPU improvement in steady streaming when using CompactStreamConnector. - Migration: existing constructors still work; opt-in with WithRetryProfile("streaming").
